description: Source code defining the SNComponent class, which represents iframe-based extension components in the application, including their properties, behaviors, and related utility functions.

classes.name: SNComponent
classes.description: Represents a component extension, with properties for URLs, permissions, activation status, and methods for conflict resolution, identity, and state checks.

methods.name: strategyWhenConflictingWithItem
methods.description: Determines conflict resolution strategy when conflicting with another item.

methods.name: singletonPredicate
methods.description: Returns a predicate to identify this component instance.

methods.name: isEditor
methods.description: Checks if the component is an editor.

methods.name: isTheme
methods.description: Checks if the component is a theme.

methods.name: legacyIsDefaultEditor
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if component is default editor.

methods.name: getLastSize
methods.description: Retrieves the last saved size of the component.

methods.name: getClientDataKey
methods.description: Returns the key used to store component-specific data.

methods.name: hasValidHostedUrl
methods.description: Checks if the component has a valid hosted URL.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Returns content keys to ignore during equality checks.

methods.name: associativeAreas
methods.description: Static method returning areas where components are associative.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Checks if the component is associative.

methods.name: isExplicitlyEnabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if component is explicitly enabled for a specific item.

methods.name: isExplicitlyDisabledForItem
methods.description: Checks if component is explicitly disabled for a specific item.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines if the component has expired based on its validity date.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Gets the feature identifier of the component.

methods.name: noteType
methods.description: Returns the note type associated with the component.

methods.name: isDeprecated
methods.description: Checks if the component is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: deprecationMessage
methods.description: Provides the deprecation message if available.
